title: The Old Pike A History of the National Road, with Incidents, Accidents, and Anecdotes Thereon

The opening sets the stage for a detailed exploration of not only the construction and development of the road itself but also of the various incidents, anecdotes, and characters that populated this vital artery of transportation in America's early years.
